title: Mirror Caves — phone-safe fallback materials

live_build.commit_note: Live index recorded Sunday Nov 15, 2026, 12:35 AM America/Chicago (last-modified 2026-11-15T06:35:13Z).

rule: If a custom shader fails to compile or link on the device (ShaderMaterial, RawShaderMaterial, onBeforeCompile hook, MeshPhysicalMaterial / transmission / clearcoat, KTX2 decoder, or a post ShaderPass), swap the named mesh's material for the MeshStandardMaterial or MeshBasicMaterial below. Do not keep the broken program. Do not attach onBeforeCompile. Pastel is already baked into these colours (palette B / L20 look-target extras). Prefer these shared instances; do not allocate a new material per mesh.

forbidden: SpriteMaterial (use a MeshBasic plane + glow-soft.png instead)
constraints.phone: WebGL1-ish: no antialias, pixelRatio 1, no float colour buffers, no logarithmic depth, shadow map <= 1024 or off, no bloom composer. One directional + one hemi + one crew point light. Mediump precision is enough. Android GPUs with low uniform limits should stay on MeshStandard/Basic with these few uniforms.
constraints.textures: Four PNG files in textures/, all 64px or smaller. Share them. Total decoded RGBA is well under 100 KB.

env-cave-gradient.note: Baked cave lighting + a warm ceiling-shaft highlight. Assign as envMap only. Do not generate a CubeCamera or reflection render target.

beam-falloff.note: Optional alpha/colour multiply on the beam cylinder. The material still reads if the texture fails to load (solid colour + opacity).

glow-soft.note: Soft radial for additive halo planes (MeshBasic, depthWrite false). Replaces the look-target Sprite halo.

hud-ring.note: Annulus used as an alpha map on a MeshBasic ground plane, replacing main.js ShaderMaterial rings.

source: GLB material name crystal-cyan on act3/levels/mirror-caves/built-crystal-cluster-{cyan,pink,gold}.glb
look-target extras.emissive.crystalCyan
meshes: any mesh whose material.name is crystal-cyan
crystal-cyan.note: No transmission, no refraction. Flat shading plus a capped emissive stands in for a faceted crystal shader. Emissive value stays <= 75% so bloom (if still on) does not blow out.

source: GLB material name mirror on built-framed-mirror.glb
zones.js B.mirror face bx(..., 0xdff4ff, ..., 0.5) — the glass pane
mirror.note: Fake reflection only: metalness/roughness + the baked cave gradient. Metalness is 0.45 (not 0.9) so the pane stays a readable light-cyan in a dark cave — a chrome-dark env would make it disappear against the wall (gray ΔE 0.4). No CubeCamera, no transmission.

dark-wood.note: Slightly lifted from the GLB #522e14 so the frame stays readable in the dark cave.

GLB material name panel on built-reflective-panel.glb
panel.note: Same fake-reflection recipe as mirror, slightly cleaner (the loose panel).

source: look-target extras.emissive.lampBeam
zones.js beamSeg / AA().beamPool MeshBasicMaterial color 0xfff27a, opacity 0.75, Additive, depthWrite false
lampBeam.note: Engine path is already MeshBasic additive (0xfff27a @ 0.75). Without bloom, a slightly stronger gold (#ffd27a) at opacity 0.48 plus the falloff as alphaMap (not as a colour map — a white colour map blew the beam to white) stays readable vs the cave. Open-ended cylinder. If the texture is missing, leave alphaMap null and keep colour/opacity.

source: look-target extras.emissive.ghostBridge
zones.js ghost() g.r.m.material when on === true: opacity 0.95, depthWrite true, emissiveIntensity 0.6
meshes: ghost / beam-lit bridge plank (g.r.m) in the lit state
ghostBridgeLit.note: Solid-enough to walk. Engine currently uses MeshLambertMaterial; swap to this Standard. Toggle with ghostBridgeUnlit on the same mesh — do not clone.

source: zones.js ghost() default / when on === false: opacity 0.25, depthWrite false, emissiveIntensity 0.3
look-target does not ship an unlit variant; this is the phone-safe unlit state
meshes: ghost / beam-lit bridge plank (g.r.m) in the unlit state
ghostBridgeUnlit.note: Must read as not-solid against the lit plank and against the cave. Darker and duller, not just more transparent. Swap fields in place (or use two shared materials and assign .material).

shared_shaders_found_in_tc_and_live.note: Current tc source and the live bundle index-I0EnmJvo.js do not contain an L20-only ShaderMaterial or MeshPhysicalMaterial for crystals, mirrors, the beam or the ghost bridge. The built GLBs are ordinary glTF PBR (no KHR_materials_transmission). The engine beam is already MeshBasic additive; the ghost bridge is MeshLambertMaterial with an opacity/emissive toggle; B.mirror is a MeshLambert pane. The custom shaders that would still run inside L20 — and that can fail on Android GPUs with low uniform limits — are the shared ones listed here. This kit still specifies phone-safe Standard/Basic stand-ins for every L20 set-piece, so Noodle can swap if a later crystal/mirror/beam shader is what crashed, or if pastelize / sky / bloom / flap / HUD rings fail.

files.what: pastelize() onBeforeCompile (saturation/lift/warm into MeshStandard); makeSkyB() ShaderMaterial dome
sky ShaderMaterial dome (same role as makeSkyB)
makeFlapMaterial() onBeforeCompile vertex animation for bee/bat wings
buildRing() and buildStamRing() ShaderMaterials (carry + stamina). Not L20-specific but drawn while playing L20.
grass onBeforeCompile + a ShaderMaterial. Meadow grass should not be in the cave; skip it on L20.
onBeforeCompile season tint. L20 has no seasons (Fern).
rain + rainbow ShaderMaterials. L20 has no weather.

shared_shaders_found_in_tc_and_live.live_bundle: index-I0EnmJvo.js bundles the L20 look-target JSON (crystalCyan, lampBeam, ghostBridge extras) and the valley / card entries, but not a playable act3-maps mirror_caves recipe and not an L20-only shader. MeshPhysicalMaterial / transmission hits in the bundle are three.js library code, not game constructors.

material_counts.budget: Look-target instancing guide: <= 12 distinct materials on Low, <= 20 on High. The 12 set-piece materials cover Low if you reuse crystal-cyan for slingGem, skip panel when the framed mirror is in use, skip skyFallback (use a solid background), and keep HUD rings off until needed. High may use the full optional set (20).
